item.title: John Lewis pulls plug on affordable homes venture after costs soar

item.title: More beavers released in Highland glen in ‘wildlife success story’
item.description: Another family of beavers has been released into a Highland glen marking a “wildlife success story” four centuries after the animals were driven to extinction, conservationists have said.
